# Ramp

English · [Русский](../ru/companies/ramp.md) · [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md) › [Companies](../README.md#companies)

Fintech and payments · International · Loop reviewed 2026-09-29

Ramp's engineering blog explains how it hires forward deployed engineers: drive and work ethic come first, and engineering fundamentals are a bar to pass rather than the main signal. Seven of its sixteen FDEs had founded companies.
